semiconductor_relevance: Medium — Sangir Plastics provides thermoplastic solutions essential for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Sangir Plastics Private Limited specializes in high-quality thermoplastic solutions for the semiconductor industry, offering products such as piping systems, sheets, and liners made from advanced materials like PVDF, PFA, PPH, and HDPE. These products are crucial for handling chemicals and ensuring reliability in semiconductor manufacturing processes.
